figures.finding: Pitcairn, a British overseas territory, does not take United Kingdom tax, and none of the 48 chapters of its laws, nor the later ordinances listed by its government, imposes an income, payroll or sales tax.
figures.applies: Pitcairn, Henderson, Ducie and Oeno Islands

sources.said: ARRANGEMENT OF CHAPTERS cap. 1 Interpretation and General Clauses cap. 2 Judicature (Courts) cap. 3 Justice … cap. 11 Local Government cap. 12 Immigration … cap. 21 Post Office cap. 22 Social Welfare Benefits cap. 23 Trade Unions and Trade Disputes cap. 24 Dental and Medical Practitioners cap. 25 Currency cap. 26 Sale and Use of Liquor cap. 27 Pitcairn Souvenir Agency cap. 28 Apiaries

figures.finding: No ordinance of Pitcairn levies income tax, so a resident pays none.

sources.said: ARRANGEMENT OF CHAPTERS cap. 1 Interpretation and General Clauses cap. 2 Judicature (Courts) cap. 3 Justice … cap. 11 Local Government cap. 12 Immigration … cap. 21 Post Office cap. 22 Social Welfare Benefits cap. 23 Trade Unions and Trade Disputes cap. 24 Dental and Medical Practitioners cap. 25 Currency cap. 26 Sale and Use of Liquor cap. 27 Pitcairn Souvenir Agency cap. 28 Apiaries

figures.finding: No social contributions are levied: benefits under the Social Welfare Benefits Ordinance are paid out of the revenues of the island.

sources.said: There shall be charged on and paid out of the revenues of the island all such sums of money as may from time to time be granted by way of any benefit under the provisions of this ordinance.

figures.finding: No law of Pitcairn imposes VAT, GST or a sales tax on a freelancer's fee.
